name: Alexander Kolchak
summary: A naval officer and Arctic explorer who commanded the Black Sea Fleet in 1916. Made War Minister of the anti-Bolshevik Directory at Omsk, he was raised to a personal dictatorship as Supreme Ruler by a coup on 18 November 1918 and held the title for thirteen months, through an offensive that reached towards the Volga in the spring of 1919 and a retreat that did not stop until Irkutsk. He was handed over by the Czechoslovak Legion that had been guarding him and shot on 7 February 1920; his body went under the ice of the Angara.
